_readme: Single source of truth for business facts and SPECIALS. Edit, then run `npm run build`. Leave a value empty ("") if it is not confirmed yet: the build skips anything empty instead of inventing it.
_reviews: Live Google reviews: set googlePlaceId + googleMapsApiKey (a browser key restricted to the site's domain, Places API (New) + Maps JavaScript API enabled). Or paste REAL Google reviews verbatim into reviews[] as { "name", "text", "rating", "date", "url" }. Never write or edit review text.
